purpose: Compare count-sensitive Stage-B structural saturation hypotheses without changing the canonical selector.
claim_boundary: All arms are project hypotheses. No arm may be promoted from proxy metrics or the development silver benchmark alone.

log_count.formula: min(1.0, 0.55 + 0.20 * log2(1 + structural_match_count)) when count > 0 else 0.0

required_development_evidence: real-corpus silver precision recall and useful-data dropout
promotion_gate: Freeze one development candidate before Qwen3-4B outcomes, then require equal-token downstream benefit and untouched confirmation.
